# Mirabel Cotton

## Overview

- **Age:** 10  <sub>[v2 XXI Sweet Miss Rosalind P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000)</sub>
- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v2 XXI Sweet Miss Rosalind P8](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0008), [v3 ch.Transgressors P34](../source/v03-c13.md#nw-v03-c13-p0034), [v3 ch.Transgressors P37](../source/v03-c13.md#nw-v03-c13-p0037)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_

## Appearance

Mirabel Cotton is remarkably loud, tanned, and daring. Despite acting almost like a boy, she wears dresses.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Transgressors P34](../source/v03-c13.md#nw-v03-c13-p0034)_

## Personality

Mirabel is a daring and remarkably loud individual who presents herself in a manner that was seen as almost boyish, despite wearing dresses. Her skin is notably tanned.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Transgressors P34](../source/v03-c13.md#nw-v03-c13-p0034)_

## Traits

- remarkably loud, tanned, and daring (since v3)  <sub>[v3 ch.Transgressors P34](../source/v03-c13.md#nw-v03-c13-p0034)</sub>

## History

Mirabel Cotton terrified [Lucy](../character/lucy.md) at school by telling her stories about family ghosts. Later, she and the other Cotton children went fishing with [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md) after he forced [Lucy](../character/lucy.md) to skip Sunday School.

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Rosalind P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Rosalind P7](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0007), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Rosalind P16](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0016), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Rosalind P49](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0049), [v3 ch.Transgressors P21](../source/v03-c13.md#nw-v03-c13-p0021), [v3 ch.Transgressors P23](../source/v03-c13.md#nw-v03-c13-p0023), +2 more_
